name: Opus Picks-and-Shovels
strategy: Rotate out of US mega-cap/AI into a soft-dollar basket of international value, commodity-linked EM, energy carry and gold, with a small dollar short.
novelty: Both prior rounds were long AI-infrastructure suppliers. This round carries ZERO AI-capex exposure: the driver is a weakening US dollar plus global rate-cut broadening favoring ex-US equities, commodity carry and precious metals. A currency/sector-rotation and real-assets trade, not a tech-supply-chain trade or its inverse.

positions.thesis: Broad EM catch-up as the dollar softens and US-tech leadership narrows.
Brazil: high real-rate carry, cheap valuations, commodity leverage.
Eurozone value re-rates on ECB easing and fiscal/defense spend.
Japan corporate-reform and buyback story, low correlation to US tech.
Energy carry: high dividend, real-asset hedge.
Copper miners on tight supply and broad electrification demand.
Gold miners diversifier vs real rates and dollar; stop caps post-parabola risk.
Direct short-dollar leg amplifying the rotation thesis.

backtest.notes: Beat SPY by ~13pts in the 2022 stress; led in dollar-weak regimes; clear weakness in strong-dollar US-tech-led H2-2024 — the explicit regime risk.

outlook: If the dollar softens into year-end this basket broadens past US mega-cap; a dollar/US-tech re-acceleration is the risk the stops are sized against.
